contentText:
The members of Santos Bravos play What Would You Queue at 2026 Billboard Latin Music Week.

Kenneth
How are you going to put that, Gabriel?

Alejandro
You already exposed us.

Kauê
What? No. Listen to it.

Hello, hello. We are Santos Bravos.

Drew
This is What Would You Queue with Billboard.

Gabriel
What song can’t I get out of my mind?

Currently.

Right now.

Actually.

Hey, you can’t lie to me, Gabi.

Ready.

We were just listening to it.

Okay, okay, okay.

Don’t steal it from me.

“Wanna Be Starting Something,” Michael Jackson.

Do we not — we don’t know him?

“Starting Something.” You gotta be starting something.

[ laughter ] What song…

…do I like to perform live on stage the most?

Oh, now! Zero.

No, but don’t copy it.

No, I didn’t, I already said-

It’s a cheat.

But that’s a lie.

That’s a lie. One, two, three.

Obviously it’s “Fe.”

Santos Bravos
Oh!

No, no.

It’s a lie. He’s lying.

No, it says here… No, it says here, it says here. “Wow” is the truth.

That’s a lie.

It says here “Wow” is the truth.

Well, why did you put fake?

To joke, it was a… It was a joke.
